database.plaintext_secret_inventory: No source secret values are intended to persist in PostgreSQL; management records, policy, session metadata and audit metadata do.

redis.plaintext_secret_inventory: Submitted encrypted payloads are temporary request/exchange state; plaintext is consumed by the browser or trusted client, not the relay audit path.

dependencies.socket_review: Authenticated Socket CLI was present, but the repository scan could not reach api.socket.dev from the execution environment. No manifest or lockfile dependency was added.

evidence_gaps: No production database, backup, installation or live-link inventory was accessed.
The Linux Fleet Pilot still requires real systemd VM and stock-client evidence.
Rust parity, broker identity and native/container fleet parity remain unimplemented.
